notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Added to the game :

- Survival mode
- New HUD
- Character Skill's
- Power up's
- New Attributes
- Leaderboard
- Upgrading
- Points
- Text Chat
- Spectating Camera on Death while another player is alive

Fixes :

Fixed an issue where you cant start a match with your friend or second player in the same party
Fixed an issue causing FPS drop
Fixed an issue with Character Footsteps sound missing
Fixed an issue game Crashes
Fixed an issue with missing sound effects
Fixed an issue with some map parts missing
Fixed an issue with Targeting / Lock on Zombies not working
And Others .....


Your Feedback is important to us and we will keep the work to improve your gaming experience with " Necrotic Haze " and we hope you would enjoy playing in the new update

x4lovi Entertainment Studio Team
